title: 第21章 欧狗吃我一拳第22章 我也给你一拳
content_zh:
;;
磨磨唧唧这么半天，可算能得到机缘了。
云阳当即选择【接受】。
【您已接受真一仙帝传承，习得《归元合一诀》】
【检测到玩家修炼功法为归元诀，现已将修行功法替换为进阶功法：《归元合一诀》】
【检测到玩家已完全习得《归元合一诀》，开启真一仙帝真正传承。】
【玩家已获得“荒古归一圣体”。】
【精+1000】
【由于玩家习得《归元合一诀》，该功法有灵肉一体的功效。】
【神+600】
【玩家获得灵气灌溉，修为境界已达到炼气期九层】
【气+500】
【玩家已获得上品道器：覆天印】
看着进入顿悟之中的云阳，秘境之中的归元道人却是心中惊讶到无以复加。
他原本被困于这秘境之中，早已沉寂许久，只是因为被云阳长久修炼归元诀，感受到相似的灵力才被唤醒。
见云阳修炼归元诀，归元道人便知道此人是自己创立的门派的后人。
归元诀脱胎于《归元合一诀》，归元道人便抱着死马当活马医的想法，看看能不能将这棘手的传承秘境摆脱，让其附在这年轻人身上，自己这一缕残魂也好消散以求解脱。
确实是死马当活马医，这传承秘境就好像赖在自己身上似的，就算当年临终时自己座下那么多天赋绝伦的弟子，都没能让这棘手的传承秘境传承下去，这区区一个三灵根天赋的家伙多半也没有多大可能能帮自己解脱。
可没想到，这个年轻人天赋虽然一般，但这悟性当真逆天，只是瞬间，便领悟自己当年终生都不得领悟完全的《归元合一诀》。
没错，是完全的《归元合一诀》，自己虽自称修炼的是《归元合一诀》，但实际上只是领悟该功法皮毛所修炼的阉割版本罢了。

只有真正的能完全领悟《归元合一诀》之人，才能真正完全获得此仙道传承。
本是打着死马当活马医的想法最后试一试罢了，没想到真的试成了！
自己竟然真的得以解脱了！
归元道人眼神灼热的看着不远处盘坐接受传承的云阳。
如今仙道传承找到了真正的传承人，这修仙界，恐怕又要掀起一场风暴了。
一颗成仙的新星正在冉冉升起啊！
而且还出自我玄天门。
甚好，甚好！
归元道人看向云阳的表情越发欣赏，不过他的身影也淡淡散去。
没有了仙人传承的束缚，归元道人的这一缕残魂也逐渐消散于这天地之间。
魂归天地，重入轮回。
而在现实之中，在云阳手机屏幕出现文字提示的一瞬间，一股庞大而又玄妙的灵气便凭空出现将他包裹在内。
这股玄妙的灵气游走过云阳的每一寸皮肤、经脉，云阳能感受到，这股灵力在不断的改造自己的身体，自己的体质在这股灵力的改造下正变得越来越强。
此次改造足足持续了两个小时，病房里灵力肆虐，但在病房外却风平浪静，没有丝毫灵力泄露。
content_en:
;;
After grinding and whining for so long, I might be able to get a chance.
Yunyang immediately chose [Accept].
[You have accepted the inheritance of Zhenyi Immortal Emperor and learned the "Guiyuan Unity Technique"]
[It has been detected that the player's practice method is Guiyuan Jue, and the practice method has been replaced with an advanced technique: "Guiyuan Heyi Jue"]
[It is detected that the player has fully learned the "Return to Origin and Unity", starting the true inheritance of the True One Immortal Emperor. 】
[The player has obtained the "Ancient Return to One Holy Body". 】
【Fine +1000】
[Because the player has learned the "Returning to the Origin of Unity", this technique has the effect of integrating soul and body. 】
【God +600】
[The player has received spiritual energy irrigation, and his cultivation level has reached the ninth level of the Qi refining stage]
【Qi+500】
[The player has obtained the high-grade Taoist artifact: Sky-covering Seal]
Seeing Yunyang entering the state of enlightenment, Taoist Guiyuan in the secret realm was extremely surprised.
He was originally trapped in this secret realm and had been dormant for a long time. He was only awakened because he had been practicing the Guiyuan Jue for a long time with Yunyang and felt similar spiritual power.
Seeing Yunyang practicing Guiyuan Jue, Taoist Guiyuan knew that this man was a descendant of the sect he founded.
Guiyuan Jue was born out of "Guiyuan Heyi Jue". Taoist Guiyuan held the idea of ​​treating a dead horse as a living horse doctor to see if he could get rid of this troublesome secret realm of inheritance and let it possess the young man, so that his remaining soul could dissipate in order to seek relief.
It is indeed a dead horse to be a living doctor. It is as if this secret realm of inheritance depends on him. Even when he was dying, he had so many talented disciples, but they could not pass on this troublesome secret realm of inheritance. It is unlikely that a guy with three spiritual roots in this area can help him escape.
Unexpectedly, although this young man's talent was average, his understanding was truly incredible. In just an instant, he realized that he had never been able to fully understand the "Return to Origin and Unity" in his entire life.
Yes, it is the complete "Guiyuan Heyi Jue". Although he claims to practice the "Return to Yuan Heyi Jue", in fact he is just a castrated version of the technique that he has only scratched the surface of.
Only those who can truly fully understand the "Gui Yuan He Yi Jue" can truly and fully obtain this immortal inheritance.
I just wanted to give it a try at the end, but I didn’t expect it to work!
I was actually freed!
Taoist Guiyuan looked with burning eyes at Yunyang, who was sitting cross-legged and accepting the inheritance not far away.
Now that the Immortal Dao inheritance has found its true inheritor, there may be another storm in the world of Immortal Cultivation.
A new star of immortality is rising!
And it also comes from my Xuantianmen.
Very good, very good!
Taoist Guiyuan looked at Yunyang with an increasingly admiring expression, but his figure also faded away.
Without the shackles of the immortal inheritance, the remaining soul of Taoist Guiyuan gradually dissipated between heaven and earth.
The soul returns to heaven and earth and re-enters reincarnation.
But in reality, the moment a text prompt appeared on the screen of Yunyang's mobile phone, a huge and mysterious spiritual energy appeared out of thin air and enveloped him.
This mysterious spiritual energy traveled through every inch of Yunyang's skin and meridians. Yunyang could feel that this spiritual energy was constantly transforming his body, and his physique was becoming stronger and stronger under the transformation of this spiritual energy.
This transformation lasted for a full two hours. The spiritual power was raging in the ward, but outside the ward it was calm and there was no leakage of spiritual power.
